name: workingforumbundle
author: Charly Martins <c.martins-prestataire@alptis.fr>
//: postcss-colormin) asks for browserslist ^4.0.0 and yarn installs a second,
nested 4.16.6 for it, which carries a high-severity advisory. npm dedupes
that copy away and reports nothing; yarn keeps it, so the lockfile this
repository actually ships had a vulnerable browserslist in it. The
resolution pins the patched line for every dependant, and ^4.28.9 still
satisfies caniuse-api's own ^4.0.0. Remove it once caniuse-api no longer
resolves to its own copy - `yarn list --pattern browserslist` shows one
